name: 韭研公社评论爬取
description: 爬取一篇韭研公社文章下的评论（用户/时间/内容）。需要微信登录态；无评论时返回空列表。

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: 文章链接；不填则用当前标签页

body.name: js

args.expression: (async()=>{const want=(p)=>{p=(p||'').trim();return (!p||p[0]==='$')?'':p;};const target=want('$url');const isArt=()=>/jiuyangongshe\.com\/a\//.test(location.href);if(target&&location.href!==target&&!isArt()){location.href=target;const t0=Date.now();while(Date.now()-t0<20000&&!isArt())await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500));}if(!isArt())return {ok:false,error:'not-article-page',hint:'请传入公社文章链接（jiuyangongshe.com/a/<id>）'};for(let y=0;y<=document.body.scrollHeight;y+=700){window.scrollTo(0,y);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,120));}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1000));window.scrollTo(0,0);const nodes=[...document.querySelectorAll('.comment-content')];const limit=Math.max(1,Math.min(Number('$limit')||30,100));const comments=nodes.slice(0,limit).map(n=>{const t=(n.innerText||'').replace(/\n+/g,' ').trim();const user=(t.split('只看TA')[0]||'').trim().slice(0,40);const timeM=t.match(/((昨天|今天)?\s*[\d-]{5,10}\s*\d{2}:\d{2})/);return {raw:t.slice(0,400),user:user||null,time:timeM?timeM[1].trim():null};});return {ok:true,fetched:comments.length,total:comments.length>=limit?'>='+limit:comments.length,comments:comments,url:location.href};})()

body.note: 滚动触发懒加载后抓取 .comment-content
